keyQuotes: In Coze 3.0, you can assemble an entire Agent Team. Tag everyone, and all hands are on deck.
First, make the Agent capable of working. Then, equip the Agent with tools. Finally, have multiple Agents collaborate.
The most obvious value of multi-Agent division of labor is that every task finds a more suitable way to be handled.
Bring in the tools you're already using and manage them with Coze 3.0. There's no need to build an 'Agent system' from scratch.
Separately, each Agent can achieve around 85 points on its own task. But if you give everything to a single general-purpose Agent, each task might only get 70 points.

mainPoints.point: Coze 3.0 Core Updates: Multi-Agent Collaboration System and Local Agent Integration.

oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth review of Coze 3.0's core updates, including multi-Agent collaboration and local Agent integration, through a complete hands-on test of building a Shopify e-commerce Agent Team, showcasing the entire process from research to prototype implementation.
originalTitle: 126 天后，扣子升级到 3.0：「@ 一下，全员就位」
summary: From the perspective of the 'Crossroads' team, this article offers a deep hands-on review of the major Coze 3.0 update. Core updates include: the Agent Team multi-Agent collaboration system, local Agent integration (supporting Claude Code/Codex/OpenClaw), and a project-based workflow overhaul. Using the construction of an e-commerce product selection Agent Team as a case study, the author breaks down the complete workflow: main Agent coordination, sub-Agent division of labor (Xiaohongshu research/overseas hot product research/product planning), and local Codex programming Agent implementation. The article particularly emphasizes the practical value of local Agent integration: users can connect their preferred tools (such as Codex) to the Coze platform, which then centrally manages and schedules them. This eliminates the need to build an Agent system from scratch, significantly reducing migration costs. The core advantage of multi-Agent division of labor is that each Agent can focus on its area of expertise, resulting in overall performance superior to a single general-purpose Agent.
title: 126 Days Later, Coze Upgrades to 3.0: 'Tag Everyone, All Hands on Deck'
